parsed.scene_description: A blurry indoor retail aisle displays multiple shelves stacked with colorful instant noodle cups. A person walks past the right side of the frame, partially obscuring the view. Overhead fluorescent lights illuminate the scene. Shelves on both sides hold various packaged goods.

objects.label: person
objects.observation: A person wearing a light-colored sweater and dark pants walks from right to left in the foreground. Their body partially blocks the view of the shelves behind them.

objects.label: shelf unit
objects.observation: Multiple horizontal metal shelves are stacked vertically on the left side. They hold numerous rows of instant noodle cups arranged in neat stacks.

objects.label: instant noodle cup
objects.observation: Dozens of colorful plastic cups containing instant noodles are stacked on the shelves. They feature various brand colors and patterns.

objects.label: light fixture
objects.observation: Long rectangular fluorescent lights are mounted on the ceiling above the aisle. They emit bright white light.

objects.label: signage
objects.observation: A black rectangular sign with white text is visible on the right side, positioned near the shelves.
